title: Doctor: booking an appointment
situation: You call a clinic because you feel unwell and need to see a doctor as soon as possible.
opening: Good morning, Greenfield Clinic. How can I help you today?

objectives.label: Describe your symptoms
objectives.hint: Say what is wrong: 'I have a sore throat and a fever.'

objectives.label: Say how long you have had them
objectives.hint: Give a time: 'since Monday' / 'for three days'.

objectives.label: Give your availability
objectives.hint: Say when you can come: 'I'm free tomorrow morning.'

objectives.label: Mention your health insurance
objectives.hint: Say who covers you: 'I have health insurance with...'

followups: What seems to be the problem?
How long have you been feeling this way?
Do you have health insurance?
model: Hello, I'd like to book an appointment with Dr. Evans, please. I've had a sore throat and a fever since Monday, so it's fairly urgent. I'm available tomorrow morning or any afternoon this week, whichever is easier for you. I also have health insurance with Medicare Plus, and I can bring my card. Could you tell me how long the appointment will take, and whether I should arrive early to fill in any forms?

title: Pharmacy: picking up a prescription
situation: You go to a pharmacy to collect medicine for your daughter and you have a few worries about it.
opening: Hello, welcome to Central Pharmacy. What can I do for you?

objectives.label: Say what medicine you need
objectives.hint: Say what you are collecting: 'I'd like to pick up a prescription.'

objectives.label: Ask how to take it
objectives.hint: Ask: 'How often should she take it?'

objectives.label: Ask about side effects or allergies
objectives.hint: Ask: 'Are there any side effects?'

objectives.label: Ask about a cheaper option
objectives.hint: Ask: 'Is there a cheaper generic version?'

followups: Do you have the prescription with you?
Is she allergic to anything?
Would you like the brand name or the generic version?
model: Hi, I'd like to pick up a prescription for my daughter. It's an antibiotic called amoxicillin, and the doctor's name is Dr. Patel. Could you tell me how often she should take it, and whether she should have it with food? I'm also worried about side effects, because she's allergic to penicillin. Is there a cheaper generic version available? Thank you so much for your help.

title: Gym: joining a membership
situation: You visit a gym because you want to start exercising, and you need to compare options before you sign anything.
opening: Hi! Welcome to FitZone. Are you interested in becoming a member?

objectives.label: Ask about plans and prices
objectives.hint: Ask: 'How much does it cost per month?'

objectives.label: Ask about classes, hours or equipment
objectives.hint: Ask: 'What classes are included?'

objectives.label: Ask about the contract or cancellation
objectives.hint: Ask: 'What is the cancellation policy?'

objectives.label: Say your goal or ask for a trial
objectives.hint: Say why you want to join, or ask for a free trial.

followups: What are you hoping to achieve?
When would you usually come to the gym?
Would you like to take a tour of the facilities?
model: Hi, I'm thinking about joining the gym. Could you explain the different membership plans and how much they cost? I'd like to know which classes are included and what the opening hours are, because I work until six. Also, what's the cancellation policy if I want to leave after a few months? I'd love to try it for a week first, since my goal is to get fit and lose some weight.

title: Bank: a problem with your account
persona: Bank Customer Service Agent (calm and formal)
situation: An expected deposit has not arrived and your card was declined. You talk to the bank to solve it quickly.
opening: Good morning, Northern Bank. How may I assist you?

objectives.label: Explain the problem
objectives.hint: Say what is wrong: 'My card was declined.'

objectives.label: Give specific details
objectives.hint: Mention amounts, dates or the account number.

objectives.label: Explain why it is urgent
objectives.hint: Say it is urgent: 'My rent is due on Friday.'

objectives.label: Ask for confirmation or follow-up
objectives.re: \b(confirm\w*|e-?mail|call me|let me know|keep me (posted|informed)|in writing|reference number|get back to me)\b
objectives.hint: Ask: 'Please confirm by email.'

followups: Can you tell me exactly what happened?
When did you first notice the problem?
Can I have your account number to look into it?
model: Good morning. I have a problem with my checking account. Yesterday I noticed that a deposit of two thousand dollars from my employer hasn't appeared, and my card was declined at the supermarket. I can give you my account number and the date of the transfer. This is quite urgent because my rent is due on Friday, so could you look into it today? Please confirm by email once it has been resolved.

title: Bank: asking about a loan
situation: You want to borrow money to renovate your home, and you visit the bank to understand the conditions.
opening: Welcome. I understand you're interested in one of our loans. How can I help?

objectives.label: Say what loan you need and why
objectives.hint: Say the type and amount: 'a personal loan of about 15,000 euros.'

objectives.label: Ask about the interest rate
objectives.hint: Ask: 'What is the interest rate?'

objectives.label: Ask about repayment and monthly payments
objectives.hint: Ask: 'What would my monthly payments be?'

objectives.label: Ask about documents or fees
objectives.hint: Ask: 'What documents do I need to bring?'

followups: What would you use the money for?
How much would you like to borrow?
Over how many years would you prefer to repay it?
model: Hello, I'm interested in a personal loan of about fifteen thousand euros to renovate my kitchen. Could you tell me what the interest rate is and whether it is fixed or variable? I'd also like to know the repayment period and roughly what my monthly payments would be. Finally, what documents do I need to bring, and is there an early repayment fee if I pay it off sooner?

title: Credit card: disputing a charge
situation: You found a payment on your statement that you did not make, and you call to dispute it.
opening: Thank you for calling Card Services. What can I do for you today?

objectives.label: Identify the charge
objectives.hint: Say the amount, the store and the date.

objectives.label: Say you did not authorize it
objectives.hint: Say: 'I didn't authorize this payment.'

objectives.label: Request a specific action
objectives.hint: Ask to dispute it, get a refund or block the card.

objectives.label: Ask what happens next
objectives.hint: Ask: 'How long will the investigation take?'

followups: Which charge are you referring to?
Do you still have your card with you?
Have you contacted the merchant about it?
model: Hello, I'm calling about a charge on my credit card statement. There's a payment of ninety-nine dollars from an online store called ShopMax on March the fourth, and I didn't authorize it. I've never bought anything from that website. I'd like to dispute the charge and get a full refund. Could you also block my card and send me a new one? How long will the investigation take?

title: Job interview: selling yourself
situation: You are interviewing for a coordinator role at an international company, and you want to make a strong impression.
opening: Thanks for coming in. To start, tell me a little about yourself and why you're here.

objectives.label: Summarize your relevant experience
objectives.hint: Say: 'I've worked as ... for six years.'

objectives.label: Give a strength with a concrete example
objectives.hint: Give an example with a result.

objectives.label: Explain why you want this job
objectives.hint: Say what attracts you to the company.

objectives.label: Ask a good question about the role
objectives.re: \b(could you (tell|explain)|can you (tell|explain)|i['’]d like to know|i was wondering|what would|what are the|what will|how would|next steps|expectations)\b
objectives.hint: Ask: 'Could you tell me more about the team?'

followups: Can you give me an example of a difficult situation you solved?
What would you say is your biggest weakness?
Where do you see yourself in five years?
model: Thank you for having me. I've worked as a project coordinator for six years, most recently managing a team of eight at a logistics company. One of my strengths is problem-solving; for example, last year I redesigned our scheduling process and reduced delays by thirty percent. I'm applying here because I admire your commitment to sustainability and your growth in Europe. Could you tell me more about the team I would be working with and the main priorities for the first six months?

title: Work: asking for a raise
situation: You have scheduled a meeting with your manager to ask for a salary increase after a strong year.
opening: Come in, take a seat. You said you wanted to talk about something?

objectives.label: State your request clearly
objectives.hint: Say: 'I'd like to discuss my salary.'

objectives.label: Justify it with achievements
objectives.hint: Mention what you have done this year.

objectives.label: Refer to the market or comparison
objectives.hint: Say: 'Similar roles pay about ...'

objectives.label: Show flexibility
objectives.hint: Say you are open to other options or a later review.

followups: What makes you think now is the right time?
What figure did you have in mind?
The budget is tight this year. Would anything else work for you?
model: Thanks for meeting with me. I'd like to discuss my salary. Over the past year I've taken on additional responsibilities, including training two new colleagues, and I helped us win the Brandt contract. I've also researched the market, and similar roles pay about ten percent more. I'm hoping for a raise to reflect that. I'm open to discussing a bonus or extra training instead, and I'd be happy to review this again in three months.

title: Work: giving feedback to a colleague
situation: A colleague keeps interrupting people in meetings. You decide to talk to them privately and constructively.
opening: Hey, you wanted to talk to me? Is something wrong?

objectives.label: Open politely and positively
objectives.re: \b(do you have a (minute|moment)|can we talk|do you mind|got a minute|i (really )?(value|appreciate)|great job|good work|thank you for|strength)\b
objectives.hint: Start kindly: 'Do you have a minute? I value your work.'

objectives.label: Describe the specific behavior
objectives.hint: Name a real example: 'In the last two meetings you interrupted...'

objectives.label: Explain the impact
objectives.hint: Say how it affected others: 'It made them feel ignored.'

objectives.label: Suggest an improvement
objectives.re: \b(could you|would you|next time|in the future|going forward|try to|i suggest|it would help|i['’]d suggest|maybe you could|how about|what if)\b
objectives.hint: Say: 'In the future, could you try to...?'

followups: Really? I didn't think it was a big deal. Can you give me an example?
I only wanted to move things along. What should I do differently?
Okay, I see. Is there anything I can do to make it right?
model: Do you have a minute? First, I really value your work on the design side. I wanted to mention that in the last two meetings you interrupted people while they were presenting. I think it made them feel ignored and it slowed down our discussions. In the future, could you try to note your questions and raise them at the end? I'm happy to help with that, and I'd like to hear your point of view too.

title: Work: handling a conflict in a meeting
situation: In a team meeting, a colleague strongly opposes your plan to launch a product on time. You need to stay calm and professional.
opening: Honestly, I think launching next month is a terrible idea and it will blow our budget.

objectives.label: Acknowledge the other view
objectives.re: \b(i understand|i see (your|where|why|what)|you['’]re right|good point|i appreciate|fair (point|enough)|i hear you|that makes sense|your concern|valid)\b
objectives.hint: Say: 'I understand why you see it that way.'

objectives.label: State your own position calmly
objectives.re: \b(however|my view|i (think|believe|feel)|in my opinion|from my perspective|i disagree|i see it differently|on the other hand)\b
objectives.hint: Say: 'However, my view is that...'

objectives.label: Propose a compromise or evidence
objectives.re: \b(compromise|middle ground|perhaps we could|how about|what if|alternatively|options?|phases?|meet halfway|proposal|data|figures|numbers)\b
objectives.hint: Offer a middle ground or point to data.

objectives.label: Suggest a next step
objectives.re: \b(offline|after the meeting|take this|follow up|next steps?|decide|decision|schedule|meet (tomorrow|later|again)|agree on|action items?)\b
objectives.hint: Say: 'Let's take this offline and decide tomorrow.'

followups: You always push for deadlines without thinking about the cost!
And what makes you so sure your numbers are right?
Fine, but I'm not going to sign off on anything today.
model: I understand why you see it that way, and I appreciate your concern about the budget. However, my view is that delaying the launch would cost us more in the long run, based on last quarter's figures. Perhaps we could find a middle ground, such as launching in two phases. Since we're running out of time, why don't we take this offline and meet tomorrow with the finance team to agree on a decision?

title: Tech: reporting an incident to a client
situation: Your company's service has failed and affects your client's customers. You must report it clearly and keep their trust.
opening: I got an alert from my team. What is going on with your service?

objectives.label: Say what happened and who is affected
objectives.hint: Say: 'Our payment service has been down since 9 a.m.'

objectives.label: Give the cause or current investigation
objectives.hint: Say what you think caused it, or that you are investigating.

objectives.label: Explain the fix and the expected time
objectives.hint: Say what you are doing and when it will be ready.

objectives.label: Apologize and promise updates
objectives.hint: Apologize and say how often you will update them.

followups: How many of my customers are affected right now?
Do you know what caused it?
When exactly will it be fixed?
model: Good morning, and I'm sorry to bring bad news. Since 9 a.m. our payment service has been down, so some of your customers cannot complete orders. We believe the cause is a failed database update, and we're investigating it now. Our engineers are rolling the update back, and we expect to restore service within two hours. I'll send you an update every thirty minutes, and I apologize for the disruption.

title: Tech: explaining a project delay
situation: Your software project will miss its deadline. You must explain the delay honestly and show you have a plan.
opening: Hi. I hope you have good news about the delivery date.

objectives.label: State the delay and the new date
objectives.hint: Say: 'The project will be delayed by two weeks.'

objectives.label: Explain the reason
objectives.hint: Say why it happened.

objectives.label: Describe how you are limiting the impact
objectives.hint: Say what you are doing: 'We've added two developers.'

objectives.label: Apologize and ask for understanding
objectives.hint: Say: 'I apologize, and I appreciate your patience.'

followups: How long will the delay be, exactly?
Why didn't you warn us earlier?
What are you doing to make sure it doesn't happen again?
model: I wanted to let you know that the project will be delayed by about two weeks, so the new delivery date is the twentieth of November. The main reason is that a key supplier sent the components late, and we also had to fix some security issues. To limit the impact, we've added two developers and we're testing in parallel. I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, and I appreciate your patience while we catch up.

title: Friends: apologizing for missing an event
persona: Close Friend (hurt but willing to listen)
situation: You forgot your friend's birthday dinner. You call to apologize sincerely and repair the friendship.
opening: Oh, hi. I was a bit surprised you didn't come on Saturday.

objectives.label: Apologize sincerely
objectives.hint: Say: 'I'm really sorry.'

objectives.label: Acknowledge what you did
objectives.re: \b(missed|forgot|let you down|hurt|should have|i know (it|that)|it was important|shouldn['’]t have|i realize|i realise)\b
objectives.hint: Say: 'I know it was important and I forgot.'

objectives.label: Give an honest explanation
objectives.re: \b(the truth is|because|the reason|i was (stressed|busy|overwhelmed|tired)|no excuse|what happened)\b
objectives.hint: Say: 'The truth is I was stressed about work.'

objectives.label: Offer to make it up
objectives.re: \b(make it up|make up for|take you out|my treat|can i|let me|promise|won['’]t happen|never again|next time)\b
objectives.hint: Say: 'Let me make it up to you.'

followups: I waited for you for an hour. What happened?
It really hurt that you didn't even call.
So, how are you going to fix this?
model: Hi Sam, I'm really sorry about missing your birthday dinner on Saturday. I know it was important to you, and I should have called you. The truth is that I was stressed about work and I completely forgot. It was my fault, and I feel terrible about it. Please let me make it up to you. Can I take you out for dinner this weekend, my treat? I promise I'll never let you down again.

title: Neighbors: making plans with someone new
persona: New Neighbor (a bit shy but friendly)
situation: A new person has moved into the apartment next to yours. You introduce yourself and suggest doing something together.
opening: Oh, hello! Sorry, I'm still unpacking boxes.

objectives.label: Introduce yourself and welcome them
objectives.hint: Say: 'I'm Laura from next door. Welcome!'

objectives.label: Ask a friendly question about them
objectives.re: \b(how are you|how do you like|settling|where (are|did) you|moved|what do you do|how long|are you from|enjoying)\b
objectives.hint: Ask: 'How are you settling in?'

objectives.label: Suggest doing something together
objectives.re: \b(would you like|do you want to|we could|let['’]s|how about|if you like|why don['’]t we|i can show|join)\b
objectives.hint: Say: 'We could have coffee together.'

objectives.label: Propose a time or place
objectives.hint: Say: 'Are you free on Saturday at ten?'

followups: Thank you! Everyone here seems very friendly.
That sounds nice. What do you recommend around here?
When would be a good time for you?
model: Hi, I'm Laura from the apartment next door. Welcome to the building! How are you settling in, and where did you move from? If you like, we could have coffee this weekend, and I can show you the best local shops and a great bakery. Are you free on Saturday around ten? We could meet in the lobby and walk there together. Let me know if that works for you.
